title: After the Satsuki Sho: One Crown Down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Run… Run away from the old me! Away from who I've been until now.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't think about anything. RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And here comes Mejiro… Palmer?! Mejiro Palmer is in the lead! And she finishes in first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer pushes herself to her limit and wins the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, wheeze… I won. It wasn't the most beautiful win, and all I did was run as fast as I could, but I still won.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Palmer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh. Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on the win. Uh, how do I put this…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You seem different. More serious… Or actually, it's more like you're scarier now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Scarier?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. When we were kids, I never saw you make a grim face like the one you had on during the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But I think that change is why you could run so well today in a huge race like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe… But…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Sorry. I haven't changed at all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I just never showed my true self before. And now, I've finally lifted my mask a little…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer! I'm the Satsuki Sho champion! Somehow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I decided to enter this race. I decided for myself I wanted to run and look what happened!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I couldn't really change Ryan's view much. I guess it's hard to convince people you aren't a Goody Two-shoes.
choice_data_list: But you made her notice you, right?
But you made her notice you, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I think I've changed a little in her eyes. She at least thinks I'm pretty good now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've gotta keep boosting my vibes even more until they get through to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The image everyone has of Mejiro Palmer being a good little kid comes from old, sepia-toned memories from her childhood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she may have been able to change the hue of that image today, even just a little bit, through her hard-earned win.
